description.value: Mountain Equipment Company (MEC) is a major Canadian outdoor retailer offering gear for cycling, hiking, climbing, and paddling. The Nanaimo location on Bowen Road serves Vancouver Island's active outdoor community with a broad range of equipment and apparel. Touring cyclists will find this a useful stop for supplies, though specific in-store bike services could not be verified from available sources.
